title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje ne Astir, Prane Vila-L 2 - Tirane (ID D8142A-50)
description_sq:
Ne Astir, Ne Rrugen Sokrat Miho, Shitet Apartment 2+1, me siperfaqe totale 100 m².
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 6-te banim (jo te fundit) te nje pallati te ri, me ashensor.
Organizohet ne ambient ndenjeje me dalje ne ballkon, ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, korridor shperndares dhe ballkon.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto, eshte i shtruar me parket dhe investuar me punime ekstra si: tavane gipsi me spote ndricimi, ballkone te mbyllur me duralumin, etj.
Disponon certifikate pronesie (Me Hipoteke)
Cmimi i shitjes: 14 000 000 ALL (140 milione leke te vjetra).
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Astir, Near Vila-L 2 - Tirana (ID D8142A-50)
description_en: In Astir, on Sokrat Miho Street, 2+1 Apartment for sale, with a total area of ​​100 m². The apartment is located on the 6th residential floor (not the last) of a new building, with an elevator. It is organized in a living room with access to the balcony, a kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a distribution corridor and a balcony. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo, it is laid with parquet and invested with extra works such as: plaster ceilings with lighting spots, balconies closed with duralumin, etc. It has a certificate of ownership (with mortgage) Selling price: 14,000,000 ALL (140 million old lek).
